title: Charlie Shavers and the lack of jealousy
summary: He remembers Shavers and says the trumpeters were friends.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Charlie? Oh, yeah. Charlie. I knew Charlie and his wife well. Charlie used to come out and we used to see each other. We used to jam together. I used to go and see him when he was with Tommy Dorsey a lot. Charlie was a good man. "Undecided." That was his big number.
All the guys. We was friends. We weren't no jealous one or jealous bunch nowhere none of them had one in himself that I knew of. I don't think (inaudible) you know?
